question.zh: 为什么他们的伪装“太完美了”？

sentences.en: Why was their disguise 'too perfect'?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们的伪装“太完美了”？

sentences.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
sentences.zh: 一辆旧公共汽车停在一条干涸的河床边，一群著名的男女演员下了车。

chunks.x: by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses

sentences.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes,
sentences.zh: 他们戴着墨镜、穿着旧衣服，

chunks.x: in dark glasses and old clothes

sentences.en: they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
sentences.zh: 采取了特别的预防措施，以免被人认出来。

chunks.x: so that no one should recognize them

sentences.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快就发现，伪装有时会太完美了。

sentences.en: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
sentences.zh: “这是个野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格利姆说。

chunks.x: This is a wonderful place for a picnic

sentences.en: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
sentences.zh: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯表示同意。

chunks.x: It could n't be better Gloria

sentences.en: 'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'
sentences.zh: “没有记者，也没有影迷！我们为什么不多来几次呢？”

sentences.en: Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，另外两位演员罗克沃尔·斯林格和默林·格里夫斯

sentences.en: had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
sentences.zh: 把两个大食品篮搬到了树下的阴凉处。

chunks.x: to a shady spot under some trees

sentences.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
sentences.zh: 大家刚安顿好，一个陌生人出现了。

chunks.x: When they had all made themselves comfortable

sentences.en: He looked very angry.
sentences.zh: 他看上去非常生气。

sentences.en: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
sentences.zh: “你们现在就出去，全都出去！”他喊道。

sentences.en: 'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says "No Camping"--in case you can't read!'
sentences.zh: “我是这里的治安官。你们看见那块告示了吗？上面写着‘禁止露营’——万一你们不识字呢！”

sentences.en: 'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall,
sentences.zh: “听我说，治安官，”罗克沃尔说，

sentences.en: 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
sentences.zh: “别对我们太厉害。我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是默林·格里夫斯。”

sentences.en: 'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
sentences.zh: “哦，是吗？”治安官冷笑着说。

sentences.en: 'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers,
sentences.zh: “那好，我是布林克斯利·米尔斯，

sentences.en: and my other name is Gloria Gleam
sentences.zh: 我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格利姆。

sentences.en: Now you get out of here fast!'
sentences.zh: 现在你们马上给我出去！”
